narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On December 2, 2024, at approximately 1530 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered the subject at a residence in Saginaw, Michigan, while attempting to locate a different person. The subject answered the door and agreed to speak with the agents.
The subject stated that he is a citizen of Mexico and showed a Mexican consular identification card. He stated that he has no immigration documents.
ENTRY:
He stated that he crossed the border illegally on foot near Sasabe, Arizona, on 02/14/2017 with a group of five, walked for two nights, and was driven to Phoenix.
TRAVEL:
From Phoenix he took a series of buses to Chicago and then to Saginaw.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
